title: Test case 8 — Armed robbery of a service station in company (the Category 2 condition)
shows: A category that turns on a fact the form asks for: armed robbery committed on or after 20 March 2017 is a Category 2 offence only if the offender had a firearm, a victim was injured, or the offence was committed in company — here, in company (admitted) — so imprisonment without a CCO is required unless an exception is established, and the app sets out the exceptions and what each needs.
